claim: Pooled AUROC decomposes as lambda*AUROC_within + (1-lambda)*AUROC_between; any question-only predictor has within-problem AUROC exactly 0.5, and with one attempt per problem lambda=0, so the whole pooled AUROC is between-problem.
stance_target: pooled probe AUROC on code is difficulty-confounded unless multiple attempts per problem are scored within-problem
scope_conditions: any binary-outcome predictor; demonstrated on MATH
quoted_support: every question-only predictor has AUROC_within = 1/2 exactly (its score is constant within a cell, so all within-cell pairs are ties) ... in the standard design with one attempt per problem (k_c = 1), lambda = 0

claim: A trace-blind difficulty proxy reaches AUROC 0.873 on 192K DeepSeek-R1 generations; a reconstruction of a published early-window probe recovers pooled 0.849 but within-problem 0.496 (t=4), statistically indistinguishable from chance.
stance_target: pooled probe AUROC reflects difficulty; within-problem signal absent in reasoning-model regime (math)
scope_conditions: MATH, R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, early window; not code
quoted_support: a closely matched reconstruction of the closest published early-window positive recovers a comparable pooled result (0.849) while within problem it is statistically indistinguishable from chance at all ten anchors (0.496 at t = 4)
